title: CrossMamba-Agri: A Vision Mamba-Based Framework for Joint Crop Disease and Pest Classification
subtitle: A Vision Mamba-Based Framework for Joint Crop Disease and Pest Classification
affiliation: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, BGC Trust University Bangladesh
supervisor: Mohammad Salah Uddin Chowdhury, Assistant Professor & Chairman, Department of Computer Science & Engineering, BGC Trust University Bangladesh
summary: A dual-head Vision Mamba (State Space Model) framework designed for joint crop disease and pest classification on the CCMT benchmark (Cashew, Cassava, Maize, and Tomato). Incorporates a Background Suppression Module (BSM) using FFT filtering with SimAM parameter-free attention, Multi-Scale Patch Embeddings, an 8-layer Bidirectional Mamba (Bi-Mamba) encoder with linear sequence complexity, and Cross-Attention Fusion routing to dual task MLPs (17 plant-condition classes and 5 pest classes). Evaluated on a 100% leakage-free parent-level split audited via perceptual hashing (pHash).

dataset.name: CCMT Dataset
dataset.description: Captured from farms in Ghana across 4 major crop types, covering 17 plant-condition categories (diseases and healthy plants) and 5 insect pest categories.

modules.name: Background Suppression Module (BSM)
modules.description: Combines 2D Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) high-frequency filtering with SimAM 3D energy-based attention to suppress field noise and soil clutter.

modules.name: Multi-Scale Patch Embedding
modules.description: Extracts non-overlapping patches at 8×8, 16×16, and 32×32 resolutions, pooled and concatenated into 196 visual tokens (D = 512).

modules.name: Bidirectional Mamba (Bi-Mamba) Encoder
modules.description: 8 sequential State Space Model (SSM) layers processing forward and backward sweeps with linear O(N) token complexity (81.13% of total parameters).

modules.name: Cross-Attention Fusion Module
modules.description: 12 learnable query vectors attending over 196 encoded visual tokens with 8 attention heads, mean-pooled to feature vector Z ∈ ℝ⁵¹².

modules.name: Dual Task Classification Heads
modules.description: Task-specific MLPs with oracle domain routing: Head 1 for 17 plant conditions, Head 2 for 5 pest categories.

leakageAudit.summary: Perceptual hashing (pHash) audit on standard benchmark splits revealed 1,851 instances of identical parent images appearing in both training and test sets (Hamming distance < 6), causing a 7.41% data leakage flaw. CrossMamba-Agri establishes a 100% clean parent-level split where all variations of any plant exist exclusively in one partition.
